title: Config and data directory loading
lead: Load settings from a TOML file plus environment overrides, and define the data directory layout.
boundary: **Not in this slice:** secrets management beyond reading paths/env; the database schema.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Portability (ADR 0016) requires that household-specific values (people, stores, recipe repo URL, timezone) live in config, not code. Every component needs the data directory (DB, recipe clone, raw emails).

sections.heading: Owner input
sections.body:
1. Config file location: `$LARDER_DATA/larder.toml` (recommended) or `/etc`-style path?
2. Timezone: in config (recommended), defaulting to the host?

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Define a frozen dataclass `Settings` with typed fields and defaults.
2. Parse TOML with `tomllib`; apply `LARDER_*` environment overrides.
3. Validate: unknown keys error; required paths exist or are created.
4. Derive data-dir subpaths: `larder.db`, `recipes/`, `emails/`, `secrets/`.
5. Keep secrets (deploy key path, IMAP password file, ntfy token) as file paths; never log them, and redact them from `repr`.
6. Add an example config and document it.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- All config tests pass.
- A review of `src/` finds no household-specific values (names, stores, URLs) in code.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Commit only when the owner asks; no AI attribution.
